# Project Closure Checklist

## Delivery
- Agreed deliverables completed or formally waived.
- Acceptance and approvals recorded.
- Final files and source assets stored in the agreed location.
- Open defects and follow-up work assigned.

## Commercial and operational
- Supplier and budget reconciliation complete.
- Usage rights, licenses, and expiry dates recorded.
- Data handled according to retention requirements.
- Reusable assets and documentation handed over.

## Learning
- Outcomes reviewed against objectives.
- Lessons and unresolved risks captured.
- Owners assigned for post-launch measurement.

Closure means ownership is transferred clearly, not simply that production work has stopped.
